candidates.title: Heterogeneous SLO Guaranteed Multi-Resource-Aware Batching in LLM Serving
candidates.reason: 短長prompt混在と異種iteration SLO下でcompute・memoryを同時最適化しKV cache早期解放まで含むbatching system。throughput 1.42–11.21倍、goodput 1.43–13.71倍。

candidates.title: ReliefServe: Relieving GPU Pressure in Multi-Model Serving via Selective CPU Escape
candidates.reason: GPU過負荷時に一部modelをCPUへescapeさせるmulti-model serving system。12-server実験で平均latency最大27.05%削減、goodput 39.74%向上。

candidates.title: SSQT: A Hardware-Friendly Fusion Compression Framework of Structured Sparsification and Sensitivity-Driven Quantization for Large-Scale Language Models
candidates.reason: structured sparsificationとlow-bit quantizationを実行layoutと共同設計。Llama2-13BでFP16比24.3% memory、A100 TPで最大2.33倍decode rate。

candidates.title: FaultSense: Fault Localization in Large-Scale Mixture-of-Experts Model Serving Infrastructure
candidates.reason: 大規模MoE servingのGPU straggler・通信path gray failureをapplication layer probeで局所化。個別component検査比で診断test数を最大20倍削減。

discovery_stats.axis: forward citations of PagedAttention/vLLM memory-efficient LLM serving
